name: Happy's Humble Burger Cult: Trial by Fryer
summary: Trial by Fryer Update introduces a new PvP mode ("Trial by Fryer"), two themed restaurants ("Roost" and "Pig Pen"), and a massive cosmetics overhaul with 76 masks, 17 outfits, and 19 hats. The update also adds co-workers, progression changes, enemy reworks, and significant performance improvements, including rebuilt materials and better reflections. It also adds new soundtracks, voice packs, and accessibility options.
